name: Water Chestnuts Wrapped in Bacon
description: Bacon-wrapped water chestnuts marinated in a savory mixture of soya sauce and Worcestershire sauce, then baked until crispy.

recipeInstructions.text: Marinate bacon in soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, garlic salt, and minced onions for 1 hour.
Wrap bacon around chestnuts and secure with toothpicks.
Cook in a 350°F oven until bacon is done.

keywords: bacon-wrapped water chestnuts, appetizer, savory snack
